visual.general_description: Demographics table of Rural Health ECHO participants by cohort 1, cohort 2 and total.
visual.detailed_description: White table with a header row (Demographics; Cohort 1 participants N = 32 (%); Cohort 2 participants N = 74 (%); Total participants N = 106 (%)) and four bold section rows: Reside or work in a rural PA county (Rural, Urban, NA), Area of practice (Primary care, Specialty, Non-clinical care), Occupation (Physician, Advanced practice provider, Nurse, Other, Not applicable/missing) and Self-reported burnout (five burnout-scale statements and Missing/NA). Each row prints a count with a percentage in parentheses in the three columns; the Not applicable/missing occupation row prints 0 (0.0), 1 (1.4) and 1 (0.94), and the total column for the Missing/NA burnout row prints 7 (6.6).

visual.general_description: Table of mean self-reported knowledge before and after each ECHO session, with differences and p-values.
visual.detailed_description: White table with a header row (Cohort; Session; Pre knowledge mean (95% CI); Post knowledge mean (95% CI); Difference (post-pre) mean (95% CI); p-value). Rows list nine sessions for cohort 1 and nine for cohort 2, each with its sample size n after the session title, followed by a bold final row Overall (n = 167). Each row prints three means with 95% confidence intervals in parentheses and a p-value written as a number or as < 0.001; a GLP-1 session title carries an asterisk.
